description:
## Why
Owner decisions: one flat fixtures/ and numbered names for everything. The 574 files in fixtures2/behavior/ are named without numbers.

## What changes
Each behaviour fixture and its sidecars (expected.*, oracle.exs) move to `fixtures/NNNNN_<stem>.*`; path-routing prefixes (`a-`, `ja-`) keep working; references in code, docs and tickets are updated. Trial names become `matrix::NNNNN_<stem>::<path>`.

## Signal
fixtures2/behavior/ is gone.
title: Move the behaviour fixtures into fixtures/ with numbers
